name: vivia
description: Keep coding project context across sessions. Track tasks, dependencies, and decisions.

interface.shortDescription: Task graph and context for coding agents
interface.longDescription: Use Vivia to keep Codex focused across project sessions. Vivia tracks projects, tasks, dependency edges, implementation decisions, execution records, and stage-specific context. Agents can find ready work, blocked work, and the next action.
defaultPrompt: Use $vivia to show what is ready, blocked, and next.
Use $vivia to plan the next task.
Use $vivia to record what changed after this task.
